turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give my son a zero, and why wasn't I called first?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite of what, exactly? You haven't shown me a single thing he did wrong.
Who decided on the zero is still open. So is whether you have any evidence at all.
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4. I'll want it in writing. Now tell me why he needs a rewrite at all.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hello Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite that would replace Owen's zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still want to see whatever evidence you have, to know who decided on the zero, and to have that offer confirmed in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Her fallback position; she accepted nothing, but your promise that nothing goes on his record met her one fixed demand, and she still wants to see your evidence, learn who decided on the zero, and get that promise in writing. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you named it, but without evidence she had no reason to agree.
What moved her: Promising that the rewrite would replace the zero and nothing would go on his record, because protecting his record is the one thing she never gives up.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite before showing any evidence, because to her a remedy with no case behind it looks like punishment first and proof later.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. You showed no evidence, so you never came near that night. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided and why she wasn't called, start by owning that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show one dated piece of Owen's own work before you mention a rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
